title: Jewel Toned Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A malty, creamy, and comforting Egyptian dish featuring miniature marshmallows, perfect for a sick day, with a blend of high protein ingredients and a touch of brine dryness.
instructions: In a large pot, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic in a little water until the onion is translucent.
Add the rinsed lentils, chopped carrots, tomato paste, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let it simmer for 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the miniature marshmallows and let them melt into the stew.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, topped with a dollop of plain yogurt.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Let the stew cool, then refrigerate or freeze it for later use.
